messages:
alex: Quick check — kernel + KV sprint status? Need a short roll-up for PMs: milestones, current blockers, and any infra deps. Who's owning the canary rollout?

maya: Owning the canary plan. Milestone: finish kernel hotpatch + perf tests by Thu EOD. Blocker: one flaky perf test in `seq-len=2048` scenario. Investigating.

kevin: Kernel PRs: PR#482 (attention opti) is ready for review, PR#489 (kv eviction) needs another pass. Ping @maya for perf numbers.

maya: saw PR#482 perf +6% p50 in local runs. Still running full CI perf matrix; flaky test is only failing on p3a-large, looks infra-y.

priya: KV warmup experiments: pre-warm + LRU tweak reduced cold-start tokens by ~35% in synthetic bench. Need eng-infra to enable larger batch runner for end-to-end test.

kevin: Small config snippet for the eviction tweak:
```
# runtime config fragment
kv.eviction_policy = "lru_ratio"
kv.lru_ratio = 0.12
continuous_batch.max_gap = 8
```
wil apply in a feature branch, will open PR by EOD.

ci-bot: build status — perf-matrix (full) started for branch `kevin/kv-evict-fix` — job id 9382.

alex: @priya what infra exactly do you need? Can we use the dedicated perf pool or do we need eng-infra assistance to reproduce p3a-large?

priya: Need access to dedicated perf pool with 4x p3a-large and the workload collector enabled (trace + token-level). Eng-infra permission gate is the blocker.

sre-oncall: I can raise the ticket to eng-infra now. ETA for approval is ~4–6 hrs depending on capacity.

maya: If eng-infra can grant access today we can run full matrix tonight and ship the kernel hotpatch Thurs AM. Otherwise fallback plan: ship kernel hotpatch behind a gate and postpone KV rollout.

kevin: CCed in PRs and will mark reviewers. Requesting @alex for final signoff on canary policy (percentages + fallback).

alex: Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 50% over 6 hours, auto-rollback on error rate >0.5% or latency p95 regress >20%. I'll draft the rollout note and update the project board.

maya: tagging the perf test that fails: `perf/seq2048_endtoend.test`. If anyone can triage infra logs, ping me.

priya: once eng-infra gives pool, I'll run warmup+eviction combo and post numbers here.

kevin: quick ask — if reviewers could skim PR#482 today that'd unblock canary. tiny changes, mostly kernel scheduling comments. :thumbsup:

alex: thanks team. I'll drop the canary doc in the project card and @mention reviewers. Short async follow-ups only — we want the PM summary by tomorrow morning. :rocket:
